en: The postcard shows a black and white photograph of an elegant, columned hall with high arched ceilings and tall windows, possibly of neoclassical design. At the bottom, handwritten or printed in old-style script, are the words 'Bad Pyrmont' and 'Wandelhalle-Innenansicht,' indicating the location and the specific view (inside the Wandelhalle, a historic spa building). The reverse has typical postcard features: divider for message/address, publisher information, and a stamp marking from the 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.' There is additional text in German specifying print details.
